summary: Fed held rates at 3.50%-3.75% on April 29, 2026. 8-4 split — one dissenter (Miran) wanted a cut; three others opposed an easing bias. Inflation noted as elevated partly due to Middle East energy prices. Powell's last meeting as chair; he will remain on the Board of Governors.
